title: Find the gap between their lines
titleKid: Find the gap behind their midfielders
brief: Your centre-back fizzes the ball into your #6, who turns to face forward.
briefKid: Your defender passes to your midfielder, who turns to face their goal.
question: Your #6 is free and facing forward. Where do you go to receive?
questionKid: Your teammate is free and facing forward. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: Get beyond their midfield line into the gap in front of their defence, at least 3 m from any opponent and with a clear lane to the ball: one pass to you there takes their whole midfield out of the game.
takeaway.kid: Get into the gap between their midfielders and their defenders, where you are free.

misconceptions.text: You stayed in front of their midfield, so a pass to you beats nobody and their #8 can step in and press you.
misconceptions.textKid: You are in front of their midfielders. Get behind them, into the gap.

misconceptions.text: You came back toward your #6, who is free and facing forward, so you only crowd the ball and drag their midfield toward it.
misconceptions.textKid: Your teammate is free, so don't run to the ball. Find the gap ahead.
